refnamediv.refpurpose: Calculate Burg maximum-entropy power spectral density.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [psd, f_out] = pburg(x, poles, freq, Fs, range, method, plot_type, criterion)

listitem.para: Required number of poles of the AR model (integer scalar).
Frequencies at which power spectral density is calculated (real vector or integer scalar). Default is 256.
Sampling frequency in Hertz (real scalar). Default is 1.
Frequency range of the spectrum ('half', 'onesided', 'whole', 'twosided', 'shift', or 'centerdc').
Method to calculate power spectral density ('fft' or 'poly'). Default is 'poly'.
Type of plot ('plot', 'semilogx', 'semilogy', 'loglog', 'squared', or 'db'). Default is 'plot'.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `pburg` function calculates the power spectral density (PSD) of a signal using the Burg method. It is a wrapper for `arburg` and `ar_psd`. The function supports various options for frequency range, computation method, and plotting.
